domain.text: PR #177 implements automatic Done-column cleanup for closed issues/task PRs and actionable notifications for qualifying issue closures.

impressions.text: The Luna worker paused twice: first to ask whether to continue, then after reporting failing watcher tests and missing acceptance work; the orchestrator directed it to continue and switched the model to Sol.

Sol reported passing the full suite and checks, then addressed review feedback that unconditional CLOSED notices were noisy by suppressing notices for PRs, own actions, and issues closed by merged PRs while preserving peer NOT PLANNED notices.
The orchestrator approved the revised behavior for owner review and noted that the first poll would report historic hand-closed issues once; the PR was subsequently graded.
